observations.code_quote: Clockodo is a cloud-based time-tracking and project-management tool for agencies, service firms, and freelancers. This connector syncs your Clockodo time entries, attendance, absences, target hours, yearly co-worker reports, customers, projects, services, users, teams, and supporting reference data into the PostHog data warehouse so you can join tracked time and billing data with your product and revenue data.
